title: 2115 Prairie, the Armour house, built from its photograph
items: 2115 Prairie Avenue, the Kelley/Armour house, now stands on the 1911 map's plan, read off a winter photograph of the house: a banded stone front with round-arched windows, the arched door at the head of a broad stoop, a south pavilion under its own taller roof, and a slate mansard with arched dormers and a tall stack.
